title: Tab does not indent an editable paragraph
evidence: The focused paragraph remained at indent level 0 after a trusted Tab key press; the fixed-toolbar command worked on the selected paragraph.
verification: A fresh isolated paragraph check set data-indent=1 after a trusted Tab press in Chromium and Firefox; the focused TipTap unit test also passed. No related production code changed after the baseline, so the original observation is retained as a state-dependent historical result rather than an open general defect.

title: Table column resizing is disabled
evidence: No resize handle is rendered in edit mode; the client configures CustomTable with resizable: false.

title: Saving a copied Draw.io diagram reuses the source attachment
evidence: After copying a Draw.io node and saving the copy, both nodes still referenced the same attachmentId, so editing the copy can replace the source asset.
verification: Focused copy-on-write regression passed in Chromium after the fix.

title: WebKit upgrades local HTTP subresources because of the production CSP
evidence: On the configured HTTP audit origin, WebKit upgraded manifest, script, stylesheet and window-config requests to HTTPS and failed them with SSL connect errors. The test strips only the upgrade-insecure-requests directive to continue the feature audit.
